title: The Crow and the Serpent
summary: A starving crow saw a venomous snake basking in the sun upon a rock. Swooping down, the crow seized the serpent in his talons....
full_text:
A starving crow saw a venomous snake basking in the sun upon a rock. Swooping down, the crow seized the serpent in his talons.

The viper instantly coiled back, striking the bird in the throat with deadly venom.

Dying upon the sand, the crow gasped: "Alas, what madness possessed me to seize a prize that carried my own doom!"
moral: In snatching at a prize, beware lest you seize your own executioner.
